name: Photos
source:
When Rhem meets Luke, the chemistry is clear. But Luke is an Instagram model and Rhem refuses to be photographed. Will their relationship survive if Rhem won’t be photographed with Luke?

[From [url=https://neil-triffett.itch.io/photos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当雷姆遇见卢克时，化学反应一目了然。但卢克是一名Instagram模特，而雷姆则拒绝被拍照。如果雷姆不与卢克合影，他们的关系还能维持下去吗？

[来自[url=https://neil-triffett.itch.io/photos]Itch.io[/url]]
